python3 - <<'EOF'
path='docs/demo-plan.txt'
text=open(path).read()
before='krok pierwszy'
after='krok drugi'
assert before in text; text=text.replace(before,after)

xcrun xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Demo.xcodeproj -scheme Demo -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData > .build/demo-build.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; rm -rf .build/results/demo.xcresult; xcrun xcodebuild test-without-building -project Demo.xcodeproj -scheme Demo -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,id=00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -collect-test-diagnostics never -resultBundlePath .build/results/demo.xcresult -only-testing:DemoUITests/ScreenshotFlowTests/testIndexScreen > .build/demo-test.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; mkdir -p .build/shots/raw; xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path .build/results/demo.xcresult --output-path .build/shots/raw >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f .build/shots/old-index.png; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,os,shutil
src='.build/shots/raw'
manifest=json.load(open(os.path.join(src,'manifest.json')))
saved=[]
for test in manifest:
  for item in test.get('attachments',[]):
    label=item.get('suggestedHumanReadableName','')
    file=item['exportedFileName']
    if file.endswith('.png'):
      name=label.split('_0_')[0]
      shutil.copy(os.path.join(src,file), os.path.join('.build/shots', name + '.png'))
      saved.append(name)
print(sorted(saved))
EOF
rm -r .build/shots/raw
description: Build, run the intro screenshot test and export the PNGs
